text: Replace the additive user/item ID scorer with a low-rank factorization-machine scorer: retain separate user and video bias terms, add 32-dimensional user/video embeddings, and score each impression as bias_user + bias_video + dot(user_embedding, video_embedding); keep pointwise BCE, the existing validation early stopping, and the fixed primary metric unchanged.
rationale: The additive model cannot represent user-specific video preferences, while a bounded 32-dimensional interaction captures them with linear memory and computation in the observed IDs. Test whether the change improves primary, GAUC, and nDCG@5; inspect Precision@5, Recall@5, MAP@5, MRR@5, and HitRate@5 to identify top-ranking effects, classification metrics to detect separation or threshold tradeoffs, and positive_rate plus score mean/std/min/max to detect distribution collapse or instability.
